fact: The party decided this location would be their first stop in the caverns.
source_quote: The party decided their first stop would be the cavern of the stone giants.
subject: Stone Giant cavern

fact: The party arrives at the Stone Giant cavern.
source_quote: The party arrives at the Stone Giant cavern
subject: party arrival

fact: Hgraam is currently dealing with an afflicted brother who has succumbed to the two-headed curse.
source_quote: They found Hgraam already contending with another of his brothers who had succumbed to the two-headed curse
subject: Hgraam

fact: Hgraam's brother is twisted and confused due to the curse, described as having 'gotten a little bit loopy.'
source_quote: his massive form twisted and confused
subject: two-headed giant brother

fact: The two-headed giant brother is currently with Hgraam in the cavern.
source_quote: They found Hgraam already contending with another of his brothers
subject: two-headed giant brother

fact: Thorin presents Hgraam with the ritualistic two-headed statue.
source_quote: Thorin presented the stone giant leader with the ritualistic two-headed statue they had recovered.
subject: statue presentation

fact: The two-headed statue was recovered from the Derro.
source_quote: statue they had recovered ... the Derro had been using dark rituals
subject: two-headed statue

fact: Thorin tells Hgraam that the Derro were using dark rituals to drive giants into a rampage.
source_quote: He explained that the Derro had been using dark rituals to drive the giants into a rampage.
subject: Thorin's explanation

fact: Hgraam probes whether the ritual was the work of the derro ruling council.
source_quote: Hgraam probed whether the ritual was the work of the derro ruling council.
subject: Derro council involvement

fact: The party chooses not to confirm specific council involvement, adhering to Zalthir's suggestion.
source_quote: The party chose the "we don't know who they were" defense
subject: party's vague response

fact: Zalthir suggested the party claim ignorance about the Derro's specific affiliations.
source_quote: Zalthir suggests: "Say that these are crazy derro and they were screaming and chanting. We don't know what the deal was."
subject: Zalthir

fact: Thorin succeeds on a persuasion check (13) to maintain the party's vague stance.
source_quote: Thorin's persuasion roll (13, with advantage as a giant-friend) held.
subject: persuasion check

fact: Hgraam gravely accepts the statue.
source_quote: Hgraam accepted the statue gravely
subject: Hgraam accepts statue

fact: Hgraam uses the statue to begin a cure for his afflicted kin.
source_quote: declaring that with it he could begin to cure his afflicted kin.
subject: cure initiation

fact: Hgraam gives the party five hundred gold pieces as a reward.
source_quote: He pressed five hundred gold pieces into the party's hands as a reward.
subject: reward payment

fact: The party receives 500 gold pieces from the giants.
source_quote: He pressed five hundred gold pieces into the party's hands
subject: 500 gold pieces

fact: The Stone Guard is becoming increasingly agitated.
source_quote: the stone guard have become more agitated recently
subject: Stone Guard

fact: Hgraam closes the Gracklstugh cavern to outsiders while he consults the stones.

subject: cavern closure

fact: Thorin asks Hgraam if he knows a way to the Overbright.
source_quote: Thorin asks whether Hgraam knows a way to the Overbright.
subject: Thorin

fact: Hgraam states he does not know where the Overbright is, or if it exists.
source_quote: Hgraam does not know where it is, or whether it exists
subject: Hgraam

fact: Hgraam mentions that 'little people' have told him the Overbright exists.
source_quote: Although I have been told by little people like you that it does.
subject: Hgraam

fact: The DM noted that dwarves who are not giant-friends take offense at being called 'little people.'
source_quote: The DM noted that dwarves who are not giant-friends take offense at being called "little people."
